title: What Claude may do while planning
intro: Plan mode is on. Pick what Claude tries to do next and see whether it goes ahead.

inputs.label: Claude's next step
options: Show the plan and you approve it

show.title: Allowed
show.detail: Reading and exploring is what plan mode is for, so Claude can look through files to work out an approach.

trace.text: Reads src/auth.ts to understand the login flow.

show.title: Not yet
show.detail: Edits to your source files stay blocked until you approve a plan. Claude has to describe the change first.

trace.text: Plan mode: source edits wait for an approved plan.

when.equals: Show the plan and you approve it

show.title: Plan approved
show.detail: Approving leaves plan mode. You choose how the work continues: with edits accepted automatically, or with each edit checked by you. You could also say no and keep planning.

trace.text: Leaves plan mode and starts the work.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of Claude's next steps to see how plan mode handles it.

quiz.question: How do you switch to plan mode during a session in the terminal?
options: Press Shift+Tab until the status bar shows plan mode
quiz.explanation: Shift+Tab cycles the permission modes. You can also type /plan, or start with claude --permission-mode plan.
